Verify your device

Each BlareX Sense unit has a unique Device ID and unique Setup Code. Both are required for first-time pairing.

Important: the Setup Code is for owner verification. The device should also have a separate hidden device secret/key for secure device-to-server authentication.
Production app can scan a real QR code printed on the case/box.

    Device & Security

    Identity, ownership, pairing credentials and connectivity.

    Device Identity

    Every physical unit should have a unique factory identity.

    Ownership & Security

    Recommended V1 account/device security structure.

    Primary Owner
    OWNER
    Device authentication: use a hidden per-device secret/key stored in firmware. Do not use the visible Setup Code as the permanent device-to-server secret.
    Do not ship a common default password such as admin123 across all devices.

    Suggested Backend Contract

    Minimum state/commands required to replace the local simulation with real hardware connectivity.

    POST /auth/login POST /devices/claim { "device_id": "BX-SENSE-A7F29C41", "setup_code": "483921" } GET /devices/:deviceId/status { "online": true, "presence": false, "relay": false, "mode": "auto" } POST /devices/:deviceId/command { "command": "set_mode | relay_on | relay_off" } PUT /devices/:deviceId/automation PUT /devices/:deviceId/intrusion Device Events: presence_detected presence_cleared relay_on relay_off intrusion_detected device_online device_offline
